Welcome. This site is my **public research journal** on machine unlearning.

I write here to think out loud: each post captures one idea, formalises it, and
records what remains unclear. Posts are deliberately written in a reusable
structure (*Context / Idea / Formalisation / Open questions / References*) so
that they can be lifted more or less directly into my thesis manuscript later.

Nothing here is peer-reviewed. Expect half-formed ideas, dead ends, and the
occasional sign error.
